rulesets.label: Current campaign navigation contract

objectives.label: Route to the requested operation
goal_facts: The requested child mode is identified before any combat action.
Navigation state is distinct from combat rules.
objectives.description: Use the hub only to locate a child experience; do not infer a shared combat engine from menu placement.

constraints: The hub contains mechanically different child modes.
Current UI recognition must precede child-mode planning.
success_facts: The target child mode is open.
No combat or resource commitment occurred during routing.
notes: Campaign is a navigation taxonomy, not a single gameplay ontology.

rulesets.label: Challenge disambiguation contract

objectives.label: Resolve the parent mode and ruleset
goal_facts: A challenge is linked to a parent mode, event, difficulty, or mission set.
No standalone rules are assumed from the word Challenge.
objectives.description: Treat Challenge as a variant or mission context until the current screen and rule panel identify its parent.

constraints: The same label is reused across legacy Z-Virus difficulty and time-limited events.
Legacy Wasteland Challenge was superseded by Biohazard Frenzy.
success_facts: Parent mode and applicable ruleset are known.
Advice is version-scoped.
notes: Never map Challenge to a single global mode id.

rulesets.label: Legacy three-hero adventure

objectives.label: Clear the story stage
goal_facts: Three heroes survive the stage.
Required enemies or bosses are defeated.
Stage items and clues may be collected.
objectives.description: Legacy real-time RPG stages used separate Adventure skills and shared energy.

constraints: Legacy rules must not be applied to the current reworked mode.
Frontline, backline, shared energy, and manual skill placement were legacy-specific.
success_facts: Stage completion registered.
Rewards or clues were awarded.
notes: Retained only for historical evidence and old account screenshots.

rulesets.label: Current scavenging survival run

objectives.label: Survive the expedition
goal_facts: The run-specific team is built.
Resources and weapons are collected.
The team survives the timed zombie pressure.
objectives.description: Current Z-Virus emphasizes assembling during the run, scavenging, arming, avoidance, tactical choices, and quick reactions.

constraints: Run state is temporary and must be observed on-screen.
Legacy chapter walkthroughs are non-authoritative for this ruleset.
success_facts: Run or stage completion is shown.
Progression rewards are available.
notes: Confirm the exact account cohort and Italian UI before generating a detailed walkthrough.

rulesets.label: Current squad progression

objectives.label: Clear and star the stage
goal_facts: Enemy waves or boss are defeated.
Star conditions are met when practical.
Progression and Memory Store rewards are unlocked.
objectives.description: Instanced PvE that uses Battle squads and troop progression rather than the current Z-Virus run engine.

constraints: Troop tier, squad capacity, hero pairing, beasts, focus fire, and positioning may all matter.
Exact star conditions must come from the current stage panel.
success_facts: Stage is cleared.
Star count and reward changes are observed.
notes: Do not promise a required troop tier; community reports differ by account strength and execution.

rulesets.label: Arena of Freedom

objectives.label: Earn points and promotion
goal_facts: Formation battles increase seasonal points.
Promotion conditions are met.
objectives.description: Historical lower arena that promoted qualifying commanders to Arena of Glory.

constraints: Closed after the season ending 21 April 2025.
Currency and promotion rules were seasonal.
success_facts: Historical rank or promotion was registered.
notes: Keep only for migration of historical screenshots and records.

rulesets.label: Arena of Glory

objectives.label: Improve Glory tier and ranking
goal_facts: The five-squad formation is valid.
Opponent selection and formation improve expected points.
Seasonal currency is claimed before expiry.
objectives.description: Automated formation PvP where pairing, front/back placement, area damage, sustain, and counters matter more than world-map movement.

constraints: Battle is simulated; field movement, rally, and garrison actions do not apply.
Five-squad count is community-confirmed and should be checked against the current UI.
success_facts: Battle result and point delta are observed.
Tier, rank, or currency improved.
notes: Opponent commitment should remain confirm_each.

rulesets.label: Current world-map field combat

objectives.label: Achieve the local battlefield objective
goal_facts: The requested target or area is controlled.
Unfavorable engagements are avoided.
Hospital and casualty limits are respected.
objectives.description: Freely maneuver individual squads to intercept, focus, flank, screen, escort, or retreat according to the enclosing event objective.

constraints: Casualty policy is inherited from the enclosing map or event.
Target strength, counters, distance, allies, hospital capacity, and safe territory must be observed.
success_facts: Objective progress increased.
Squads returned or remain combat-capable within the user's risk budget.
notes: Never automate hostile PvP targeting without explicit confirmation.

rulesets.label: Current cooperative rally

objectives.label: Defeat the rally target
goal_facts: The correct target is selected.
Rally capacity and troop-type requirements are satisfied.
The target is defeated within the casualty budget.
objectives.description: Combine allied troops under one rally captain for targets too strong or restricted for solo attack.

constraints: Leader configuration is decisive.
Joiner hero and bonus contribution is an unresolved public-source conflict and must be verified by current battle reports.
Target type changes the applicable talents and risk.
success_facts: Target defeat or objective damage is recorded.
Participant losses and contribution are captured.
notes: Starting hostile rallies is suggest_only; joining consumes troops and requires confirmation.

rulesets.label: Current garrison defense

objectives.label: Hold the defended structure
goal_facts: A suitable garrison captain is leading.
Reinforcement troop type matches the defense plan.
The structure remains controlled or protected.
objectives.description: Static defense of a shelter, tower, gate, or event building under a designated captain.

constraints: Garrison talents are contextual.
Captain and reinforcement contribution must be read from current reports.
Casualty policy is inherited from the enclosing event.
success_facts: Structure control persists.
Defense report and casualty deltas are recorded.
notes: Captain selection is suggest_only; reinforcing is confirm_each.

rulesets.label: Regular Pompeii battlefield

objectives.label: Win by alliance battlefield score
goal_facts: Alliance score exceeds the opponent at battle end.
Buildings, transport objectives, PvE, and PvP roles contribute according to current rules.
Personal reward thresholds are pursued without overriding team objectives.
objectives.description: Instanced alliance battle combining building capture and hold, transport objectives, field PvP, rallies, garrisons, zombies, and boss activity.

constraints: Exact duration, building names, score weights, eligibility, healing, and casualty policy must be read from the current in-game rules.
Legacy guides describe a one-hour red-vs-blue battlefield but may be stale.
success_facts: Alliance victory or final score is recorded.
Personal score and reward tier are recorded.
Post-battle healing state is known.
notes: Assign role-specific objectives instead of recommending open-field combat to every participant.

rulesets.label: Pompeii Glory League

objectives.label: Advance through the Glory League
goal_facts: Regular-season wins and points improve alliance standing.
Knockout rounds are won under their fair-stats and Tactical Orders rules.
Roster locks and participant timing are respected.
objectives.description: Twenty-three-week league variant with regular season, knockout stages, current fair-stats adjustments, faster movement, and officer Tactical Orders.

constraints: Participant roster restrictions apply after registration.
Fair Stats and Tactical Orders vary by knockout round.
Officer actions require alliance authority.
success_facts: Round result and league standing are recorded.
Tactical Order use and objective impact are captured.
notes: Do not merge this ruleset into regular Pompeii.

rulesets.label: Current Bounty Ground

objectives.label: Survive and improve placement
goal_facts: The squad remains inside the safe zone.
Mercenaries, defeated players, buffs, and airdrops improve survival odds.
Unfavorable early PvP is avoided.
objectives.description: Solo battle royale with a shrinking safe zone, temporary troop growth, power-ups, airdrops, and escalating PvP.

constraints: Initial troop caps and lobby tiers are volatile.
Buff inventory, safe-zone timing, healing, and airdrop state must be observed live.
Alliance rally and garrison logic do not apply.
success_facts: Final placement and rewards are recorded.
Temporary power growth and elimination cause are captured.
notes: The historical Silver-lobby 10k cap is evidence, not a current constant.

rulesets.label: Current Island Raid remake lineage

objectives.label: Maximize alliance rank through coins and control
goal_facts: Alliance territory reaches priority settlements and outposts.
Prism Coin production and plunder improve combined ranking.
Troops, hospitals, Aid Station, and Rescue Elixirs remain within the alliance risk budget.
objectives.description: Three-day alliance war lineage with watchtower expansion, settlements, outposts, Miasma, coalitions, war declarations, temporary helipads, and Coin Plunder.

constraints: Eligibility, warzones, active-member thresholds, map timing, and building names are version- and cohort-dependent.
Persistent casualties and healing costs are high.
Official 2025 tower death-rate numbers require current in-game confirmation.
success_facts: Coin ranking and objective control improve.
Casualties, aid recovery, healing cost, and personal contribution are recorded.
notes: All hostile and relocation actions remain suggest_only or confirm_each.

rulesets.label: Current world-map zombie hunt

objectives.label: Defeat the selected zombie efficiently
goal_facts: Target level matches the goal and squad capability.
Stamina and event timing are respected.
EXP and drops are captured.
objectives.description: Individual world-map PvE for hero experience, manuals, drops, missions, and event points.

constraints: Consumes stamina.
Available zombie levels depend on progression and Federation history.
Zombie Hunter effects are context-specific.
success_facts: Zombie defeat and rewards are recorded.
Stamina delta and hero EXP gain are known.
notes: Automatic repeated hunting requires an explicit stamina budget.

rulesets.label: Current Hivemind alliance rally

objectives.label: Defeat the Hivemind
goal_facts: Alliance rally reaches sufficient capacity and strength.
Zombie/Hivemind-specific loadout is used.
Alliance and personal rewards are obtained.
objectives.description: Alliance-only PvE rally boss that is distinct from a normal zombie target.

constraints: Requires an Alliance and rally participation.
Battle Center capacity, target level, leader strength, troop tier, and participant availability matter.
Consumes stamina or rally energy according to current rules.
success_facts: Hivemind defeat and rally report are recorded.
Alliance Gift and personal rewards are observed.
notes: Do not model Hivemind as a solo zombie.

rulesets.label: Current leader and support beast system

objectives.label: Match leader and support beasts to the squad goal
goal_facts: Leader element and skills match the encounter.
Support-tagged effects complement the leader and squad.
Chip and inheritance effects are included without double counting.
objectives.description: Independent combat layer with leader and optional support beasts, elements, skills, Potential, Promotion, Chips, Arrays, and support inheritance.

constraints: Support unlock and inheritance depend on research and progression.
A support beast's leader skill is inactive.
Beast buffs to Squad Skill DMG must be separated from beast skill damage.
success_facts: Assignment is legal.
Observed battle reports show expected beast and squad modifiers.
notes: The user's +3% Tiger text is consistent with the Blaze Sabretooth leader deployment bonus at an intermediate tier.

rulesets.label: Current Extreme Showdown

objectives.label: Win the one-hour alliance battlefield
goal_facts: Alliance tactics, objectives, superweapon timings, rallies, and garrisons produce the winning result.
The selected tactical preference supports the assigned role.
Healing-return choice is considered before battle.
objectives.description: Successor to Genesis War with a one-hour battle, selected time slot, tactical preferences, timed superweapons, Tactical Orders, and reward-choice tradeoffs.

constraints: Alliance officers select schedule and may issue Tactical Orders.
Current map, scoring, casualty, and reward-choice rules must be read in-game.
Legacy Genesis War guides may be stale.
success_facts: Battle result and score are recorded.
Superweapon and Tactical Order outcomes are captured.
Healing and reward-choice consequences are known.
notes: Genesis War should remain a deprecated alias/ruleset lineage, not the active canonical label.

actions.label: Recognize current mode and variant
preconditions: A current game screen or rule panel is observable.
effects: Produces a mode_id, ruleset_id, game version, locale, and confidence estimate.
notes: Low-confidence recognition must stop execution and request another observation.

actions.label: Open Campaign Hub
preconditions: Campaign section button is recognized.
effects: Displays campaign child modes.

actions.label: Inspect current mode rules
preconditions: Mode or event rule entry is visible.
effects: Captures access, timing, scoring, casualty, and reward facts with provenance.
notes: In-game rules outrank community guides for current numeric facts.

actions.label: Select operational objective
preconditions: Mode, ruleset, user goal, and current state are known.
effects: Creates a bounded objective and risk budget.

actions.label: Configure heroes and troops
preconditions: Mode loadout rules and available roster are known.
effects: Changes leader, assistant, troop type, troop count, and equipment assignment.
notes: Do not spend upgrade materials as part of configuration.

actions.label: Configure leader and support beasts
preconditions: Beast feature and requested support slot are unlocked.
Current beast roster is known.
effects: Changes leader beast, support beast, and applicable squad modifiers.
notes: Never promote, level, or replace chips without separate authorization.

actions.label: Deploy squad
preconditions: A valid loadout and destination are selected.
Risk and casualty policy are known.
effects: Places a squad into the selected map or instance.
notes: Deployment can expose troops even before combat.

actions.label: Move squad
preconditions: Destination and route are visible.
No higher-risk target is implicitly selected.
effects: Changes squad position and engagement geometry.

actions.label: Focus selected target
preconditions: Target identity, hostility, strength, and expected consequence are known.
effects: Begins or redirects combat toward the selected target.
notes: Hostile PvP targeting is suggest_only even when this generic action is otherwise confirm_each.

actions.label: Retreat or recall squad
preconditions: Retreat path or recall control is available.
effects: Attempts to end exposure and return the squad to safety.
notes: May be auto-allowed when a user-defined hospital or casualty guard is crossed.

actions.label: Start rally
preconditions: User has rally authority and a verified target.
Leader loadout, capacity, timer, and casualty policy are known.
effects: Creates an alliance rally against the target.
notes: Never start a hostile rally autonomously.

actions.label: Start Hivemind rally
preconditions: Alliance participation is available.
Target level and rally strength are verified.
Stamina budget is approved.
effects: Creates a PvE rally against a Hivemind.

actions.label: Join rally
preconditions: Leader, target, requested troop type, capacity, and departure time are known.
effects: Commits selected troops to the rally.

actions.label: Reinforce garrison
preconditions: Garrison captain, structure, requested troop type, and casualty policy are known.
effects: Commits selected troops to a defensive structure.

actions.label: Capture battlefield objective
preconditions: Objective ownership, unlock state, defender, and team plan are known.
effects: Attempts to transfer objective control and scoring.

actions.label: Hold battlefield objective
preconditions: Objective is allied and defense plan is known.
effects: Maintains control, production, or score over time.

actions.label: Transport objective item
preconditions: Pickup, delivery point, safe route, and current ownership are known.
effects: Moves a scoring object toward an allied delivery objective.

actions.label: Gather temporary event resource
preconditions: Resource is temporary, available, and safe enough to collect.
effects: Adds temporary power, currency, materials, or objective value.

actions.label: Attack world-map zombie
preconditions: Target level, squad, stamina budget, and event multiplier are known.
effects: Starts PvE combat and may grant EXP, manuals, drops, or points.
notes: Repeated execution requires an explicit count or stamina cap.

actions.label: Queue Arena battle
preconditions: Formation and opponent preview are visible.
Attempt cost and expected points are known.
effects: Consumes an attempt and resolves an automatic formation battle.

actions.label: Enter Bounty Ground match
preconditions: Lobby, loadout, entry cost, and available time are known.
effects: Commits the commander to a Bounty Ground instance.

actions.label: Use battlefield buff
preconditions: Buff identity, duration, target, and opportunity cost are known.
effects: Applies a temporary battlefield effect.

actions.label: Relocate shelter or battle base
preconditions: Destination legality, safety, cost, cooldown, and alliance plan are known.
effects: Changes shelter or battle-base position.

actions.label: Issue alliance Tactical Order
preconditions: User has officer authority.
Order, target, Tactical Point cost, and team timing are verified.
effects: Consumes alliance tactical resources and changes battlefield conditions.
notes: Never execute alliance-authority actions autonomously.

actions.label: Heal wounded troops
preconditions: Wounded count, resource cost, speedup cost, event return policy, and hospital limit are known.
effects: Reduces wounded count and consumes healing resources or event items.
notes: Large batches or premium items require explicit confirmation.

actions.label: Claim earned reward
preconditions: Reward is earned, visible, and does not force an unwanted choice.
effects: Transfers earned items or currency to the account.
notes: Choice chests and mutually exclusive rewards are excluded.

actions.label: Exchange event currency
preconditions: Currency balance, expiry, item value, limits, and user priority are known.
effects: Consumes event currency and grants selected items.
notes: Never auto-spend seasonal currency.
